Shared GameplayRules scalar arithmetic/tap rebase withdraws genuinely inapplicable predictions permanently, preserves independent predictions and applies late accepted withdrawn originals normally.

Same-process not-admitted resume preserves original request IDs/intent/FIFO while updating only generation; old socket/read callbacks and account switches cannot repopulate a cleared account. Fresh sessions reconstruct no outgoing queue.

HTTP summaries do not block advancing older actual replicas. Gaps trigger staged recovery; interleaved and duplicate revisions catch the staged generation up before publication. A stale download cannot mark the advertised newer head ready.

PostgreSQL/HTTP baseline export covers current retained root and controlled shared-reducer scalar revision records plus definitions; immutable multi-chunk R remains readable while the incremental suffix advances. Outcomes are account scoped, HTTP absence remains unknown, manifests/chunks are private, and expired exports fail.

Nullable non-board revision envelopes advance accepted revision at the same gameplay node while preserving valid predictions in incremental and baseline paths; this is extension infrastructure, not implementation of future chat/history controls.

Final record seam selection: 14 tests across four retained JUnit suites, no failures/skips. Earlier affected selection separately passed 4 existing GameSession and 8 preparation-transfer regressions. Initial two Kotlin compile failures are retained as diagnostics.
